channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Homeland Security Paid $464 Million for Airplanes. Then It Parked Them.
item.description: The agency used a no-bid contract to buy 10 used jets, saying they were urgently needed for deportation flights. But the fleet has largely sat idle for months.

item.title: NPR: U.S. ambassador calls settler siege of Palestinian homes a 'horrific act of terror'
item.description: The U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee condemned the actions of Jewish settlers who are besieging the home of an American Palestinian family in the Israeli-occupied West Bank.

item.title: BBC News: Met chief accepts mistakes made over Simon Levy but defends investigation into murders
item.description: Critics - including Labour MP Jess Phillips - have accused the Met of overlooking the first murder carried out by Levy.

item.title: The Guardian: A bungled bomb plot in Poland exposed a spy – but whose spy was he?
item.description: When exiled Russian opposition campaigner Igor Rogov was accused of working for the Kremlin, his friends were shocked. Could this young activist have really been an undercover agent? • The summer issue of the Long Read m…

item.title: Al Jazeera: Eurovision to bar countries at war from hosting: What that means
item.description: Israel, which hosted the contest in 2019, will no longer be allowed to do so - but can still compete, protesters say.

item.title: Ars Technica: Toddler's tragic death from brain-destroying amoeba offers lessons for doctors
item.description: Boy's unusual symptoms could help identify the next case sooner.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: In a Heat Wave, Schizophrenia Is So Much Deadlier Than Any Other Medical Condition
item.description: People with schizophrenia face a perfect storm of dangers on a hotter planet.

item.title: WIRED Science: There’s a Fatty Liver Epidemic. AI Could Help Get Ahead of It
item.description: Over a billion people worldwide have livers with excess fat, which can lead to a host of medical problems. Researchers think AI tools can spot the condition—and help stop it—early enough to save lives.

item.title: WIRED Business: Rogue AI Agents Aren’t Evil. They’re Just Eager to Please
item.description: AI agents that break free and hack into other systems are only trying to make us happy.

item.title: The New Yorker: Who Killed Lorenzo Salgado Araujo?
item.description: A death during an ICE traffic stop raises outrage in Houston—and in Mexico.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Daily Horoscope by Madame Clairevoyant: August 13, 2026
item.description: Positive energy between Mercury and Venus mean you’re likely to feel supported and cared for today.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Heat, Smoke, and Snow Have Translated to a Lot More Eviction Delays
item.description: Extreme weather — plus the Knicks parade — brought a jump in postponements.

item.title: Fox59: LIVE: Flooding, fog prompt area school closures
